result:
**Fix:** RESTWS-1037 was fixed by PR #743 (merge commit `070fa8bca3b59292118da26461b3d2cfd9a06796`, merged 2026-05-27). The bug was that `PRIVILEGE_DENIED`, a sentinel returned when the caller lacks a child resource's read privilege, leaked into serialized lists and maps. Serializing it produced "No serializer found for class java.lang.Object", which surfaced as HTTP 500 on `GET /visit/{uuid}`. The fix makes any collection or map containing the sentinel return the sentinel itself, so the parent property is dropped. `BasePageableResult` skips denied items instead of adding them.

PRs #744 (`0644380dbce500f3e4b4f64742e9247c59629d77`) and #745 (`ab57d35718277f6489ed290b21b83e7a5273528b`) are cherry-picks of the same change onto other branches. They are not the original fix, so I left them out of the array.

**Implementation (post-fix state at `070fa8b`):**
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtil.java:364-373`: `getPropertyWithRepresentation` returns `PRIVILEGE_DENIED` if any collection element is denied. This is the main change.
- `ConversionUtil.java:397-406`: the collection branch of `convertToRepresentation` propagates the sentinel.
- `ConversionUtil.java:411-419`: the map branch propagates the sentinel the same way.
- `ConversionUtil.java:430-434`: the existing check that produces the sentinel when `getRequiredGetPrivilege()` is not held. It is unchanged by the PR but is the source of the value.
- `ConversionUtil.java:67`: the `PRIVILEGE_DENIED` sentinel declaration.
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/resource/impl/BasePageableResult.java:52-60`: skips denied items when building results (+5/-1 in the PR).
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/resource/impl/DelegatingResourceDescription.java:243-258`: `evaluate` propagates the sentinel for collection-valued properties (+7/-2 in the PR).
- `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/ConversionUtilPrivilegeTest.java:1-230`: new test file (230 added lines, no deletions) covering the sentinel behaviour. I did not check the exact line count of the file.

Caveats: I read the ConversionUtil diff directly. The line ranges for the other two main files come from the PR's changed-file stats and the post-fix file contents, not from their hunks. I did not run the tests.
